scope: PAMF direct: joint-domain primary results plus pooled two disjoint populations

SIG_TIME_clarification.NO_TIME: Remove explicit time coordinate, retain descriptor branch
SIG_TIME_clarification.NO_SIGNATURE: Remove full SIG-TIME path-descriptor branch; same experiment, not a second removal
SIG_TIME_clarification.SIG_TIME: Historical single-view control; excluded from this report

pooled_accuracy: Trace of summed population confusion matrices / 168000
pooled_macro_f1: Recomputed from summed six-class confusion matrices; not an average of population F1
aggregation_order: Per seed, sum populations within each scene; compute metrics; mean six practical scenes; then three-seed mean and sample SD
